title: Sea Happy
meta_description: Sea Happy is a bright coastal home with a garage arcade lounge, bikes, deck \& access to a 5,000 sq ft resort-style pool.
description_expanded:
Sea Happy earns the name without trying too hard. The living room, dining area, and kitchen run together in one bright open stretch, so nobody's stuck cooking alone while the rest of the group debates beach plans.

Behind the garage door is a converted hangout with bar-top seating, an arcade game, and a TV --- the default landing spot when the afternoon turns rainy or the evening runs long. The deck out back has comfortable seating for everything in between.

All three bedrooms sit upstairs: a king primary with its own ensuite, a second king room, and a full-over-full bunk the kids will claim first. A full-size laundry room handles the sandy towels, and the kitchen arrives fully stocked.

Prominence carries the rest. Guests have access to the 5,000-square-foot resort-style pool and the community gym, with The Big Chill at the neighborhood's center --- restaurants, shops, and a 25-foot outdoor LED screen running movies and live music through the season. Two bikes come with the house for the Timpoochee Trail.

On 30A between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach, you're about half a mile from Deer Lake State Park, where a long boardwalk crosses protected dunes to one of the quietest stretches of sand on this coast. Walton Dunes is a couple of miles west with no stairs to the beach, Santa Clara a little farther with restrooms and peak-season lifeguards, and Pier Park about half an hour east.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets under 50 lbs each for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine.
- HOA only allows golf cart rentals with 30A Gulf Carts; no other golf cart rentals are allowed.
- This home does not have a fitness center.
- Pack n' play travel crib, high chair, and child gate are available upon request.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- 2 parking spaces available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
